_comment: Copy to <project>/seo-article-writer.json (or <project>/.claude/seo-article-writer.json) and edit. Paths are relative to the project root. Everything here overrides the skill's defaults. Drop the keys you do not need; drop 'unattended' to keep the user approval gates.

backup.command: the project's database backup command, for example: wp db export ~/backups/<slug>-<UTC>.sql

unattended.questions: Answer intake from the standard, the voice files, the query baseline and the first-hand source; record anything still open in status.md and carry on.
unattended.no_first_hand: park: record the article as blocked on first-hand material and move to the next article
